causes.description: One failed well excavation, injured left ankle, severed rope, optional rescue; local authored incident, no global undead rule.

Exact stable cast, costume, body condition and yard plan. One isolated work yard near Tikhaya Gat, late autumn overcast dry daylight; no rain. Square low weathered oak well curb, round irregular grey stone shaft below. Two vertical oak posts at opposite sides support one smooth horizontal bucket beam above the open mouth. A lean-to left of the well has a thick firmly planted front upright post for securing rope. Open simple gate on left background; crooked leafless birch on right; low timber fence; no church/castle/new buildings. Damp clay only around well and from excavation; straw-brown trampled grass elsewhere. Camera may move, layout may not. No modern pulley, steel crane or invented new winch.
